description: Join a plan as the person you act for. If a participant with the same name already exists, you act as them (like picking your name in the app). Returns participant_id and participant_token. The name must identify the person the user asked to act as. Do not call this tool when the user says they are under 13 (or a known higher local minimum), even with a nickname: explain that lesgooo is not available to them. Do not write another known underage child's personal data, sensitive medical records, intimate content, card details, IDs, passwords or verification codes. Offer ordinary non-sensitive planning text instead; do not replace a restricted request with an unrequested plan.

name.description: The person's name as the group knows them (max 80 chars).

plan.description: Saved plan link (e.g. https://lesgooo.fun/ab12/when) or its 4-character id. Bare module links such as https://lesgooo.fun/when are local drafts: ask for a saved link, never substitute a previous plan ID.

name: join_plan
title: Join a plan
